globe.status.terra: Still observing, but its orbit is drifting: orbit-keeping manoeuvres have stopped. NASA expected observations to continue into late 2026.
globe.status.aqua: Still collecting data, but drifting freely since its last drag make-up manoeuvre in December 2021, slowly sinking below the A-Train.
globe.status.snpp: NASA FIRMS no longer delivers new Suomi NPP VIIRS fire data. Historical data stays available, and FIRMS points users to NOAA-20 and NOAA-21.
globe.status.noaa20: Declared fully operational by NOAA after its checkout phase (formerly JPSS-1).
globe.status.noaa21: In orbit; NASA has handed its operations over to NOAA (formerly JPSS-2).
